finding: BR-131 counts a deletion inside a function's line range. A deletion of the last lines of one function lands between its new end_line and the next start_line, so it lies inside neither range. State in BR-131 that such a deletion counts for both neighbouring functions (DEC-37). Owner: domain-modeling-agent.
why_this_severity: An implementer can choose a reading and the gate still ends with a verdict (no to fails_purpose); the test writer must guess which function a border deletion judges (raises_cost). No story or code outside the run encodes the statements.
